No screen value and no split, the main table's "Screen value / share" row reading "not priced" with its cause and what clears it (anchor.value_withheld, absent where unset); applicable, the recipe and the tier untouched; the dated current on show with the median beside it, never priced in its place; a multiple_stale flag, one detail line and the reason; the mid-cycle sentence says R1 would price the median where the value is withheld (stale, or no usable current); the split's stale notice and its arithmetic state the anchor's cadence verdict, never a flat 30-day clock (TJX's 75-day ex-lease close is not stale); never re-struck at the page's close; an anchor written before carries none of it
